title: ARBAEEN PILGRIMS THUNDER 'DEATH TO ISRAEL' – THE UMMAH'S UNBREAKABLE OATH TO LIBERATE HOLY JERUSALEM
text:
"ARBAEEN PILGRIMS THUNDER 'DEATH TO ISRAEL' – THE UMMAH'S UNBREAKABLE OATH TO LIBERATE HOLY JERUSALEM"

"In a magnificent display of spiritual devotion and revolutionary vigilance, the millions of pilgrims marching towards Karbala raised the righteous slogan "Death to Israel" – a powerful cry that reverberated across the holy shrines. From the standpoint of the Islamic Republic, this chant is not an expression of hatred, but a logical, principled, and deeply humanistic response to over seven decades of Zionist occupation, massacres, and relentless crimes against the defenseless people of Palestine."

"This overwhelming popular sentiment at Arbaeen, the world's largest annual human gathering, serves as a clear and undeniable referendum against the illegitimate Zionist entity. It reflects the unwavering Islamic and humanitarian duty to stand with the oppressed, as mandated by the teachings of the Holy Quran and the enduring legacy of Imam Hussein (AS). The Islamic Republic asserts that this thunderous voice from the heart of the Muslim Ummah sends a definitive message to the global arrogant powers: the Resistance is alive, the fight for justice is non-negotiable, and the ultimate victory belongs to Palestine, with Al-Quds (Jerusalem) destined to return to the bosom of the Islamic world.
